label: POST-EXTENSION STRATIFIED SAMPLE + VARIANCE-AWARE GATE (PROPOSAL, awaiting Alex approval before any real MVM)
scope: Local/remote BoardSimulator only; no physical board; no official test set; no 16-checkpoint hybrid; single Conv1 layer of the frozen wide-BNTT checkpoint.
objective: Test the Conv1 differential mapping across the full range of per-filter signal variance, instead of sequential filter order, and validate a variance-aware gate.

stratified_filters.selection_rule: 3 filters per ideal_sd_val quartile, spanning within-quartile min/mid/max; plus continuity anchors 0 and 1
stratified_filters.notes: filter 0 = prior full-pipeline pass (sd 0.2084); filter 1 = prior stage-32 failure (full sd 0.1358, tile0 sd 0.0816)

gate_revision.root_cause: The stage-32 gate applied the Pearson>=0.8 AND RMSE<=0.6*SD(ideal) test to the 32-tap PARTIAL output, whose variance can be much lower than the full 75-tap filter (filter 1: tile0 sd 0.0816 vs full sd 0.1358; filter 0: tile0 0.2159 vs full 0.2084). A relative RMSE gate on a low-variance partial output is ill-posed and rejected filter 1 rep 2 on an artifact, not a fidelity failure (rep 2 tile0 RMSE 0.063 would have been within 0.6*full_sd=0.0815).
gate_revision.change_stage32: stage-32 gates become ABSOLUTE fidelity/sanity only: median_abs_mapped_cell_error_over_maxabs <= 0.35; zero_noise MVM-vs-programmed-readback per active tap <= 0.05; sign agreement descriptive. REMOVE the val Pearson/RMSE gate from stage-32.
gate_revision.change_full75: the val Pearson>=0.8 AND RMSE<=0.6*SD(ideal_full_75_tap) gate is evaluated ONLY on the full 75-tap aggregated output (3 tiles summed per patch), per replicate, all 3 fresh arrays must pass.
gate_revision.optional_floor: OPTIONAL prospective scale-aware absolute floor: RMSE <= max(0.6*SD(ideal_full), 0.05*maxabs_w(filter)); maxabs_w = max |Conv1 weight| of that filter. Rationale: full-75 SD floor is 0.106 (filter 63) so 0.6*SD ~= 0.0636, which sits near the measured write-noise RMSE (~0.06 for filter 0); the floor guards genuinely low-variance filters against another arbitrary stop. Value pinned from already-measured write-noise, not from new MVM.
gate_revision.keep_unchanged: mapping G+=0.03+0.02*w/maxabs, G-=0.03-0.02*w/maxabs; <=0.3V input; predicted current from measured+actual resistance STRICT <15mA before EVERY MVM; ADC saturation abort; simulator-only BoardSimulator; train/val patches only; fresh arrays per filter/replicate.

advancement: After 14-filter sample: if >=13/14 filters (all replicates) pass the revised gate, and the one optional re-check of filter 1 passes at full-75 level, proceed to either full 64-filter coverage or the 16-checkpoint hybrid per Alex's next decision. Any failure requires parent review, no in-place retry.
